scraped.scraped_description: Open Collective is a legal and financial toolbox for groups. It’s a fundraising + legal status + money management platform for your community. What do you want to do?

name: Open Collective
tagline: Raise, manage and disburse money with full transparency.
news_articles: Guardian: 'Open Collective: the platform helping grassroots groups manage money'
TechCrunch: 'Open Collective raises funding to support open source projects'
Wired: 'How Open Collective became the financial backbone of the internet'
Reuters: 'Open Collective Foundation dissolution impacts 600+ collectives'
academic_citations: Eghbal, N. (2016). Roads and Bridges: The Unseen Labor Behind Our Digital Infrastructure. Ford Foundation.
Kostakis, V., & Bauwens, M. (2019). Network Society and Future Scenarios for a Collaborative Economy. Palgrave Macmillan.

awards: Fast Company World Changing Ideas Award (2020)
documented_limitations: Platform dependency on fiscal hosts for legal compliance
Geographic limitations based on fiscal host availability
Currency and payment processing constraints by region
failure_modes: Open Collective Foundation (US 501c3 host) dissolved in 2024 after financial difficulties
governance_model: Platform stewardship transitioned in 2024 to Open Finance Consortium Inc. (OFiCo), a US 501(c)(6) association governed collectively by fiscal hosts and communities
curation_criteria: Collectives must comply with fiscal host policies; platform prohibits illegal activities, discrimination, and harassment; transparent financial reporting required
controversies: Open Collective Foundation dissolved abruptly in 2024, leaving ~600 collectives to transition funds
legal_regulatory_issues: OCF dissolution 2024 - collectives required to find new fiscal hosts
